1_qdrant_server_disappears.mechanism: Catches ConnectError, marks SyncItem as FAILED with exponential retry backoff, zero data loss

2_network_disappears.mechanism: Sync barrier cleanly releases, state machine preserves UNPROCESSED queue state

3_ollama_disappears.scenario: Ollama service unavailable during Copilot generation
3_ollama_disappears.mechanism: RAGService catches OllamaUnavailableError, returns graceful degradation warning, local search works 100%

4_restart_during_ingestion.mechanism: SQLite transaction rolls back uncommitted chunks; file validator and unique hash prevent duplicate corruption on retry

5_restart_during_sync.scenario: Process killed while jobs are in PROCESSING status
5_restart_during_sync.mechanism: SyncQueueService.reclaim_abandoned_processing_jobs recovers stale jobs on startup (>300s timeout)

6_edge_shard_reload.scenario: Qdrant Edge restarts and reloads shard directory
6_edge_shard_reload.mechanism: EdgeShard.load verifies WAL and segment files, indexing indexes immediately without vector re-computation

7_partial_sync_failure.scenario: Half of batch succeeds, remote fails midway
7_partial_sync_failure.mechanism: Per-item status tracking marks succeeded items as SYNCED and failed items as RETRYABLE, prevents double-sync

8_repeated_retry.scenario: Remote failure persists across multiple sync cycles
8_repeated_retry.mechanism: Exponential backoff doubles delay up to MAX_BACKOFF (300s); terminates at MAX_RETRIES (5)

9_conflicting_versions.scenario: Local and cloud revisions diverge concurrently
9_conflicting_versions.mechanism: ConflictService records Conflict entry with side-by-side diff, prevents silent cloud overwrites

10_disk_storage_failure.scenario: Upload storage or shard path unwritable
10_disk_storage_failure.mechanism: File storage boundary checks reject path escape; storage errors raise HTTP 422/500 with sanitized message
